point_in_time_rule: A latest-revised series is retrospective. It is never labelled point_in_time.
assumed_lag_statement: The one-month lag is an assumption. It is not a stored release timestamp.

holdout.rule: Training decisions are strictly before this date. The holdout is run once and is not used to choose a cell.

primary_test.maxlags_rule: horizon_months minus 1, and 0 when the horizon is one month
primary_test.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg on training-window primary p-values inside the registered family. Full-sample p-values are descriptive and are not the selection statistic.

bootstrap.cell_seed_rule: The frozen seed plus the Adler-32 of the cell id modulo 100000.
bootstrap.audit_rule: A claim is withdrawn to inconclusive when the block-bootstrap interval for the slope contains zero.

ridge: Ridge is not estimated. A penalty would be a second unregistered search. Collinear cousins are one group.

pilot.transform: difference over 12 calendar months, in percentage points

features.reason: The unemployment rate is the level named in the first-pass family.
A 12-month change in a rate is the difference, in percentage points. A missing month is not bridged.
CPI-U enters as a 12-month ratio change. No surprise term is used.
Industrial production enters as a 12-month ratio change.
The federal funds rate enters as a level.
A 12-month change in the funds rate is the difference, in percentage points.
The spread is the 10-year yield minus the 3-month yield in the same month.
The 12-month change in the spread is the difference of that spread. A missing yield month is not bridged.

gate3.reason: The Sahm gap is compared with the unemployment level it is built from.
Restricted diffusion is compared with industrial-production growth, one of its inputs.
The spread is compared with the 10-year yield, one of the two inputs. It is not compared with itself.

cash_return_statement: Cash earns zero because no cash rate is stored. This is an assumption.
concentration: One listing, fully invested or fully in cash. No leverage and no second listing.
economic_comparators: invest each contribution at its own entry
invest only in March, June, September and December
12-month price momentum using only sessions before the entry
economic_rule: A contribution is retained as cash when the predeclared adverse state is true. Otherwise it is invested at that entry and held to the window end.
forward_validated: This class stays empty. Nothing in this catalogue was frozen before the outcomes existed.
